```{r key_findings}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

## templated text (cpsr::report_highlights()), see Documentation
## styled as a panel, mirroring the PDF report (kf-* classes, see cpsr.css)
hl <- cpsr::report_highlights(cps_report, pill = "html")
cat(paste0("\n::: {.kf-panel style=\"--kf-color: ",
           cpsr::color_palette[["report"]], "\"}\n\n"))
cat("\n<div class=\"kf-title\"><span class=\"kf-title-text\">Key findings</span></div>\n\n")
cat("::: {.kf-lead}\n\n")
cat(hl$lead, sep = "\n\n")
cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
if (nzchar(hl$supporting)) {
  cat("::: {.kf-support}\n\n")
  cat(hl$supporting, "\n\n")
  cat(":::\n\n")
}
cat(":::\n\n")
```
